lines.text: AMC eight challenge! Think it's sixty percent? Nope!
lines.caption: AMC 8 challenge! Think it's 60%? Nope!

lines.text: Jug A has ten liters of water, jug B ten liters of sixty percent juice.
lines.caption: Jug A has 10 liters of water, jug B 10 liters of 60% juice.

lines.text: Pour five liters from B to A, stir, then pour five back. What percent of B is juice?
lines.caption: Pour 5 liters from B to A, stir, then pour 5 back. What percent of B is juice?

lines.text: Count liters, not percents. Jug B starts with six liters of juice.
lines.caption: Count liters, not percents. Jug B starts with 6 liters of juice.

lines.text: Half of B pours over, taking three liters of juice.
lines.caption: Half of B pours over, taking 3 liters of juice.

lines.text: Now pour back one third of jug A. That's one liter of juice.
lines.caption: Now pour back 1/3 of jug A. That's 1 liter of juice.

lines.text: Three plus one is four liters out of ten. Forty percent!
lines.caption: 3 plus 1 is 4 liters out of 10. 40%!

lines.text: Did you get forty percent? Tell me below!
lines.caption: Did you get 40%? Tell me below!
